rules: Candidate approval records 9.5-plus editorial suitability; it does not authorize an App Store Connect upload.
Do not upload any listed asset while the top-level uploadAuthorized field or the file uploadAuthorized field is false.
Use only event-card and event-details inside App Store Connect In-App Event media after the controlling release and human-authorization gates pass.
Keep event media text-free and device-free.
Do not show fake app UI, fake widgets, fake phone UI, notifications, lock screens, App Store badges, ratings, prices, reviews, school names, or LMS brands.
The rejected 7.5 supplemental hero is intentionally omitted because press-only supplemental art is optional and is not App Store Connect event media.
